name: guardians-follow-dungeon-entry-and-exit
contract: Summoned guardians come along through a dungeon portal in and out: the area trigger teleport (MiscHandler.cpp HandleAreaTriggerOpcode -> Player::TeleportTo) changes map and instance, and the core removes every guardian the player owns.

Players: An Undead Necromancer (class 23) with a Lesser Skeletal Warrior (500970, creature 50065) and a Ghoul (500971, creature 50073), 1 Life Force each, and an Orc Shaman with Feral Spirit (51533, two Spirit Wolves 29264, stock guardians that last 45 s and are summoned just before each travel). Counts are owned creatures within 100 yards (owned_creature_count); Life Force pool = stacks of 805011, free Life Force = stacks of 525004. Each check compares the value after a travel with a snapshot taken just before it, so the result does not depend on the pool size at level 20: the reported actual value is after minus before (for example -2 = two guardians lost).

The exit leg also asserts the absolute counts, because without the fix the guardians are already gone at the entry and the relative checks of the exit would compare 0 with 0. Ragefire Chasm: area trigger 2230 in from the door in Orgrimmar, 2226 out of the instance. The short teleport inside the instance moves 15 yards on the same instance, which is below the far-teleport line and carries nothing. Needs CoA.Guardians.FollowTravel = 1. Expected: before the fix every check after the entry and after the exit fails; after it every check passes.
